dct_title_s: Flood impact assessment in Uribia Municipality, La Guajira Department, Colombia as of 15 November 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20241112COL, GDACS ID: 1102988** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent in Uribia Municipality, La Guajira Department, Colombia as observed from a Sentinel-2 satellite image acquired on 15 November 2024 at 10:17 Local Time. Within the analysed area of about 220 km², a total of about 24 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. UNOSAT identified 529 structures that appear to be not affected by flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
